role: The enchanting table's block entity: the floating book's page flip and rotation animation (turning toward a player within 3 blocks, with its own Random) and a custom name.
scope_reason: world.conf enchanting = off makes the table a plain block, but tables are craftable, so the entity exists and ticks on both sides.

members.name: field_145923_r
members.note: A private static Random read only by the player-near branch of updateEntity for the book's page-flip target; see updateEntity.

members.name: field_145922_s
members.note: A custom name needs a named item stack, which only an anvil makes: world.conf anvil = off.

members.name: writeToNBT
members.note: Only CustomName is written, and only an anvil sets it.

members.name: readFromNBT
members.note: cov-reload-s1 reads a table back with its chunk

members.name: updateEntity
members.note: Both branches: with a player within 3 (tt_env.closest_player, serverreplay.c:sr_closest_player) the book turns (StrictMath.atan2) and flips, drawing the class's static Random field_145923_r on the server role (enchant_rand_int_n), which the rows' d.sstat digest sees (iu-off-s1 failed there before lane/itemuse); else the no-player branch. The animation floats are not in NBT, so a table already standing at a snapshot restarts from zero natively. The client's book renderer (RenderEnchantmentTable) is not in the native rasterizer.; a snapshot's table carries the book state (tilesrt: snapshot.c snap_tile_runtime, pfc-enchjoin-f59); the client's tables tick after every entity, a rider placed by its vehicle first (pickobj_client_te_tick, pfc-ridench-f54)

notes: The animation floats affect nothing but the client book render; they matter for state equality against the oracle's tile tick rows. lane/idxblocks: world.conf enchanting = off makes the table a plain block; its tile entity still ticks, and its static Random's draws near a player are server-visible through the Det split digest (iu-off-s1). lane/reloadstate: a chunk reload restarts the book floats (serverreplay.c sr_tiles_loaded).
